mapper.insert: INSERT INTO leave_application(emp_id, leave_type, start_time, end_time, leave_days, reason, approver_id, approve_status, approve_opinion, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{empId}, #{leaveType}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{leaveDays}, #{reason}, #{approverId}, #{approveStatus}, #{approveOpinion}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE leave_application SET emp_id = #{empId}, leave_type = #{leaveType}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, leave_days = #{leaveDays}, reason = #{reason}, approver_id = #{approverId}, approve_status = #{approveStatus}, approve_opinion = #{approveOpinion}, create_time=#{createTime}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE leave_id = #{leaveId}
UPDATE leave_application SET approve_status = #{approveStatus}, update_time = NOW() WHERE leave_id = #{leaveId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leave_application WHERE approve_status IN (1, 2)
